description: This Java interface defines a mixin for thing adapters within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifying default topic groups and channels for such adapters.

classes.name: ThingAdapter
classes.description: A mixin interface for thing adapters, extending Adapter with default topic group and channel sets.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns default topic groups (THINGS) for the adapter.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns default topic channels (TWIN and LIVE) for the adapter.
